Checking for refresh token endpoints and additional HTTP interceptors.

Frontend auth interceptor located at `/bench/repo/web/src/connect.ts`. Token storage is in `/bench/repo/web/src/auth-state.ts`, managing `memos_access_token` and `memos_token_expires_at`. The refresh token is not stored in frontend localStorage; it is sent as an HTTP-only cookie via `credentials: "include"`. Backend validation interceptor is at `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/connect_interceptors.go`.

Backend core validation resides in `/bench/repo/server/auth/authenticator.go` (`Authenticate`, `AuthenticateByAccessTokenV2`). Token parsing is in `/bench/repo/server/auth/token.go`. Token extraction is in `/bench/repo/server/auth/extract.go`. Next checking `auth_service` for refresh token endpoints and `authorizer.ng/co`.

value.text: The repository structure and authentication flow are now fully mapped.

## Frontend

| Path | Role |
|---|---|
| `web/src/connect.ts` | **Primary HTTP auth interceptor** — `authInterceptor` on Connect transport; sets `Authorization: Bearer …`, preflight refresh, retries on `Unauthenticated` |
| `web/src/auth-state.ts` | Token storage/sync (not the interceptor itself) |

**Tokens managed**

| Token | Storage | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| **Access token** | `localStorage` key `memos_access_token` | Sent as `Authorization: Bearer <token>` |
| **Access token expiry** | `localStorage` key `memos_token_expires_at` | Used for preflight expiry checks |
| **Refresh token** | HttpOnly cookie `memos_refresh` | Not in JS; sent via `credentials: "include"` to `AuthService.refreshToken` |

**Related (not the interceptor):** `web/src/hooks/useTokenRefreshOnFocus.ts` — proactive refresh on tab focus; `web/src/lib/query-client.ts` — defers to interceptor, no retry on `Unauthenticated`.

---

## Backend

| Path | Role |
|---|---|
| `server/router/api/v1/connect_interceptors.go` | **Connect auth interceptor** — `AuthInterceptor` reads `Authorization`, calls `Authorizer.Authenticate` |
| `server/router/api/v1/authz.go` | `Authorizer` — policy layer over `auth.Authenticator` |
| `server/auth/authenticator.go` | **Core validation** — `Authenticate`, `AuthenticateByAccessTokenV2`, `AuthenticateByRefreshToken`, `AuthenticateByPAT` |
| `server/auth/token.go` | JWT/PAT constants, parse/generate (`ParseAccessTokenV2`, `ParseRefreshToken`) |
| `server/auth/extract.go` | `ExtractBearerToken`, `ExtractRefreshTokenFromCookie` |
| `server/router/api/v1/auth_service_session.go` | Refresh endpoint — validates `memos_refresh` cookie, rotates tokens |

**Tokens validated**

| Token | Header/Cookie | Validator |
|---|---|---|
| **Access token (JWT v2)** | `Authorization: Bearer …` | `auth.Authenticator.AuthenticateByAccessTokenV2` → `auth.ParseAccessTokenV2` (audience `user.access-token`) |
| **Personal Access Token** | `Authorization: Bearer memos_pat_…` | `auth.Authenticator.AuthenticateByPAT` |
| **Refresh token** | Cookie `memos_refresh` | `auth.Authenticator.AuthenticateByRefreshToken` → `auth.ParseRefreshToken` (audience `user.refresh-token`, DB revocation check) |

**Flow:** Frontend interceptor in `connect.ts` attaches access token → backend `AuthInterceptor` in `connect_interceptors.go` → `server/auth/authenticator.go` validates Bearer JWT/PAT. Refresh uses cookie only, via `auth_service_session.go`.
